Issues.Title: bug(cdk/table): ordinary tables inside cdkVirtualFor throw "viewport is already attached"
Issues.Body:
Hi! An ordinary `cdk-table` inside a `*cdkVirtualFor` item throws `CdkVirtualScrollViewport is already attached.` on initial render. ### Is this a regression? I haven't verified the last working version. ### Description I want to virtualize a list of groups, with a small, ordinary table inside each group. Only the outer list should use virtual scrolling; each table should display all of its own rows. When the viewport and the item template are declared in the same component, the inner table picks up the outer viewport and tries to attach to it, even though `cdkVirtualFor` is already using it. ### Reproduction [Open the reproduction in StackBlitz](https://stackblitz.com/github/nagahara-naoki/components/tree/repro-nested-table-virtual-scroll) [Source code and local run instructions](https://github.com/nagahara-naoki/components/tree/repro-nested-table-virtual-scroll) 1. Open the reproduction and wait for the app to start. 2. Open the browser console. 3. The error appears on initial render. No scrolling or other interaction is needed. The relevant template is: ```html
{{row}}
``` The component imports `ScrollingModule` and `CdkTableModule`, and uses this data: ```ts groups = Array.from({length: 100}, (_, id) => ({ rows: Array.from({length: 3}, (_, row) => `Group ${id}, row ${row}`), })); ``` To run locally: `npm ci`, then `npm start`. ### Expected Behavior The viewport scrolls through the groups, and each group's table renders its three rows normally. ### Actual Behavior Initial rendering throws: ```text Error: CdkVirtualScrollViewport is already attached. at CdkVirtualScrollViewport.attach at CdkTable._setupVirtualScrolling at CdkTable.ngAfterContentInit ``` ### Environment - Angular: 22.2.6 - CDK: 22.2.6 - Browser: Chrome 157.0.8103.51 - Operating system: macOS I also reproduced this in a Chromium regression test against repository commit `32cf96285e1b0ae4183f0f6f1992bbe62ace4426`. ### Additional context This looks related to the dependency injection boundary addressed in #34100. That change prevents `VIRTUAL_SCROLLABLE` from leaking into virtual-for items. In this case, the inner table still resolves the outer `CDK_VIRTUAL_SCROLL_VIEWPORT` token.
Issues.RelatedDescription: Open issue "bug(cdk/table): ordinary tables inside cdkVirtualFor throw "viewport is already attached"" (#34121)

Issues.Title: fix(material/sort): use initial start direction for unsorted header arrows
Issues.Body:
Bind `.mat-sort-header-descending` and `.mat-sort-header-ascending` on the sort header container via `_getArrowDirection()` so that:
- When a header is actively sorted (`_isSorted()`), it displays the active `_sort.direction`.
- When a header is unsorted (`!_isSorted()`), its hover/focus hint arrow reflects its own initial sort direction (`this.start || this._sort.start`) instead of inheriting another sorted column's `_sort.direction`.

### Verification
- Strict Angular template/TypeScript type-check (`ngc`) and `tslint` on `src/material/sort`
- Prettier formatting check on modified files
- Executed all 27 unit specs in `src/material/sort/sort.spec.ts` (including the new regression test verifying unsorted headers retain their initial `start` direction while another header is sorted `'desc'` and when `matSortStart` changes) in headless Chrome with `TestBed` and `Jasmine` (27 passed, 0 failed)

Fixes #33933
Issues.RelatedDescription: Open PR "fix(material/sort): use initial start direction for unsorted header arrows" (#34120)

Issues.Title: feat(material/select): add a styling token for the panel shape
Issues.Body:
Adds a `container-shape` token to `select-overrides` so the border radius of the select panel can
be customized. Previously it was hardcoded to 4px, while the autocomplete and menu panels already
expose the same token.

The default rendering doesn't change. In M3 the value comes from `corner-extra-small`, so apps that
customize that system token will see the select panel follow it, like the autocomplete and menu
panels.

Apps can set it with `mat.select-overrides((container-shape: ...))`.
Issues.RelatedDescription: Open PR "feat(material/select): add a styling token for the panel shape" (#34119)

Issues.Title: fix(material/slider): align slider thumb with cursor on Firefox during drag
Issues.Body:
#### Description
On Firefox, when clicking and dragging the slider thumb, the visual thumb was pulled closer to the center of the track than the cursor, especially visible near the ends of the slider track.

This occurred because `.mdc-slider__input` did not reset native range appearance or pseudo-elements (`::-moz-range-thumb` and `::-moz-range-track`). In Gecko's user-agent stylesheet, the native range thumb has a default width of `1.4em` (~22.4px) with border insets, whereas Angular's geometry calculation assumes a 16px knob diameter (`_knobRadius: 8`). This resulted in a dead-zone where Firefox's native drag coordinates lagged behind the mouse position.

This PR:
- Resets native appearance (`appearance: none`, `-moz-appearance: none`, `-webkit-appearance: none`) and clears background on `.mdc-slider__input`.
- Explicitly sizes `::-moz-range-thumb` to 16px to match `_knobRadius` and clears borders on `::-moz-range-track`.
- Adds unit test coverage asserting native appearance reset on the input element.

Fixes #34094
Issues.RelatedDescription: Open PR "fix(material/slider): align slider thumb with cursor on Firefox during drag" (#34106)
